# Release: v2025.11.06-regions-dynamodb

This release migrates Regions Management to DynamoDB and unifies the UI flows end-to-end.

Highlights
- Backend: DynamoDB single source of truth (WizzCentral_Regions), AWS SDK v3, numeric levels (0..3).
- APIs: GET /api/regions, GET /api/regions/:id, GET /api/regions/statistics, PATCH /api/regions/:id/toggle, POST /api/regions.
- Frontend: Single Regions Management page with filters, pagination, toggle, and create region modal.
- Map: Leaflet helpers to pick or use center for coordinates.
- Auth UX: AWS SSO guidance toast on 401 (expired/missing credentials).

Breaking changes
- Legacy file-based regions removed. All reads/writes go to DynamoDB.
- Consolidated UI under frontend/pages/regions.html.

How to run locally
1) Start dev server: npm run local (task: Start Local Dev Server)
2) Health: http://localhost:3000/health (should show dataSource: dynamodb)
3) UI: http://localhost:3000/pages/regions.html

Validation steps
- List: /api/regions returns items with regionId.
- Toggle: PATCH /api/regions/baghdad/toggle flips is_active and updates timestamps.
- Stats: /api/regions/statistics uses numeric levels and returns correct breakdown.
- Create: Use Add Region modal → POST /api/regions → appears in table after save.

Env/Debug
- Guard debug endpoints with ENABLE_REGIONS_DEBUG=true.
- If 401 with error=aws-credentials, run: aws sso login --profile <your-profile>.

Roadmap (post-release)
- Edit/Delete flows, improved map UX, server-side pagination and GSIs, stricter validation.
